values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. The registering camper must be 18 or older.

summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 401): reservable, 44 campsites. Changed season (year_round false only) -> Apr 25 - Oct 16 (2027). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, electric to 50 amp (6 sites), max 30 ft, all back-in, showers/dump/water spigots. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of counts/booking/season text (the 'May-Oct' was wrong, '3 platform' not on RA).
flags: Criteria margin: only 6 of 44 campsites take a 23-ft rig - the six electric sites 35, 37, 39, 41, 50, 51 are listed '30 Back-In'; the other 38 are '20 Back-In'.
Phone: the entry has the park office (845-889-4646); ReserveAmerica says 'During May-October please contact the campground first. CAMPGROUND: 845-889-4909'. Suggest the campground number.
